kind: JKDF2 cd64 candidate combat, Force, items and live-rule qualification
scope: This receipt describes the immutable cd64 candidate only. It makes no claim that a later or final packaged bot binary was tested here. Human peace and cross-transport qualification are recorded separately.

candidate.recorded_build_method: Recompile changed units and all server-only units back to the client base; reuse verified published unchanged objects/static dependencies.

method.description: The observer verifies executable hash and process start identity and reads game memory without writing it. Samples are non-atomic at approximately half-second intervals.
method.resource_deltas: Compare endpoints that are both alive and in the same recorded life, excluding observed death/respawn resets.
method.gun_provenance: Saber deflection can change projectile parent. Firing witnesses combine selected gun, ammunition depletion, own parent, and creator GUID upper 16 bits equal to local slot+1, following sithThing_Create.
method.force_evidence: BOT_FORCE_INPUT is a request. Pull and Blinding active flags include targeting time. Effects, costs and stock COG semantics are distinguished.

completed_observers.stop_reason: Reached the 24 MiB output bound; the 600-second time limit was not reached.

Healing.conclusion: Stock Healing activated, deducted 200 mana, and raised local health from about 55.39 to 100 in the same life.

Protection.conclusion: The legal light master activated Protection after recent damage; mana fell from 400 to 100 and bin 29 became active.

Grip.conclusion: Mana fell from 400 to 350 and Grip became active. Stock Grip sets this state after release and SkillTarget; particular victim damage is not isolated.

Seeing.conclusion: Seeing became active with the stock 30-mana deduction, 32 to 2.

Absorb.conclusion: Absorb was active after normal respawn. This proves the COG entered its effect, but does not independently measure the activation deduction or damage conversion.

Pull.conclusion: Targeting ended and mana fell from 400 to 380; the stock release/cost path ran. Victim disarm is not established by these samples.

Blinding.conclusion: Targeting ended and mana fell from 400 to 300. This observer does not record victim actor blind flags, so a particular player being blinded is not independently proven.

Destruction.conclusion: Own-parent/own-creator Destruction projectile GUID 329258, signature 1717, appeared; mana fell 400 to 204, consistent with 200 cost and 4 regeneration. Impact damage is not isolated.

Lightning.conclusion: Source-backed inference: the rank-four master lost 50 then 21 net mana during logged Lightning requests, consistent with 25 per fire pulse and 4 regeneration. Stock fire deducts mana and emits a projectile in the same branch. No lightning projectile or specific impact was captured.

Force Jump.conclusion: The stock charge/release spent 20 mana with 4 regeneration. Height rose from 0.863 to 1.695 then 1.799 with ordinary sector change. Later routing stalled; this proves the Force effect, not route success.

Speed.conclusion: Speed became active with mana 400 to 380 and ensuing ordinary movement.

Bryar.conclusion: Selected Bryar, energy 50 to 49, own-parent/own-creator bry0.3do GUID 329272/signature 1731.

Stormtrooper rifle.conclusion: Selected rifle, energy 197 to 195, own-parent/own-creator str0.3do GUID 328147/signature 606.

Repeater.conclusion: Selected repeater, powercells 4 to 1, and newly observed own-parent/own-creator rpt0.3do projectile.

Rail detonator.conclusion: Selected rail detonator, charges 24 to 23, own-parent/own-creator rld0.3do GUID 329012/signature 1471.

dm_summary: All six maps reached NAV_READY and completed their 80-second fixtures: 955 valid samples, zero observer errors, no backtrace/segmentation/assertion/fatal log lines, successful fixture exits and cleanup. Pickup recognition does not imply universal route reachability.

bacta_witness.conclusion: Bacta amount fell 1 to 0 while alive and health rose 82.895 to 92.465 with Healing inactive. Concurrent damage prevents recovering the exact heal amount.

live_rule_change.sampling: Original stream until each bot first second-stream timestamp, then the second stream; overlapping samples are not double counted.

live_rule_change.conclusion: All four bots applied the live update without a PID change. After two seconds of settling: no newly seen own-creator projectiles, no alive/same-life ammunition or mana decreases, no new Force active transitions, and no further Force-input requests. Existing Boba Seeing and Kyle Speed/Seeing expired normally. Brief respawn Bryar selections had no firing evidence.

limitations: Qualification is for candidate cd64, not a later final package. Its build record describes modified client code and reused unchanged objects, not an unmodified native client or fresh dependency rebuild.
The two completed mixed observers contain 3488 and 708 valid samples with zero errors; their periods overlap. The first spans 449.040 seconds and was size-capped, rather than completing 600 seconds.
Half-second non-atomic samples can miss transient shots, casts, collisions and pickups. Absence of sampled events is bounded evidence about these runs, not proof about every tick.
Owned projectiles alone are not shot counts because saber reflections can change parents. Concrete gun witnesses include creator provenance plus selection and ammunition corroboration.

No successful live Persuasion cast is claimed. Throw and Deadly Sight were intentionally withheld under fists peace. Lightning emission is inferred from stock fire-handler semantics and mana costs; a particular impact was not captured.
Bowcaster and concussion combat were not witnessed here. DM m2 acquired concussion normally. This is not qualification of every gun or every Force matchup.

All six stock DM maps loaded and built graphs, but complete navigation is not established. Initial reachable item counts: m2 9/46, m4 42/70, m5 6/129, m10 18/42, m_boss15 1/16, m_boss17 8/13. m2 and m4 stalled; m_boss15 never left its spawn sector.
Already active effects and in-flight projectiles keep ordinary stock lifetimes when rules change. Force-off stops new inputs rather than erasing game effects.
Roster visibility of human clients does not establish their local health or peace compliance. Human peace, provocation and cross-transport conclusions belong to separate receipts.
